name: sessions
description: Side panel with this folder's sessions: status colors, sections, one-window switching, stop, restart, rename, a waiting-for-you filter, auto-pin and reopen with Remote Control, spend and token usage, a status line, and an API for other plugins

debugLogs.title: Debug logs for new sessions
debugLogs.description: Sessions the panel (n) or ccc create write Claude's debug log to ~/.claude/mods/sessions-data/debug/<name>.log, and the mod logs each step of its start there
